column1: # REGISTER 4 (PARTIAL) - mutation-proofs.wave6-dunes.tsv
# Wave-6 proofs for the Werner saltation-hop resolution (OPEN-ITEMS #27, which supersedes #11).
# Guards live in TWO files: reference-impl/tests/test_pseudocode_drift.py (the BLOCK_CONSTANTS row
# `dunes.hop` that REPLACES the retired `werner-saltation-hop` divergence) and
# reference-impl/tests/test_dunes.py (the prose-side pin that no fenced-block register can see,
# plus the two behavioural guards that keep the constant from becoming decorative).
# Written here and NOT into the shared mutation-proofs.tsv, which other agents are filling in the
# same wave. Merge target: the test_pseudocode_drift.py and test_dunes.py rows of
# mutation-proofs.tsv.
# EVERY CELL BELOW IS FROM EXECUTION, none predicted. The harness for each trial was:
#   1. read the live SUBJECT file into memory   4. restore the exact original bytes from memory
#   2. apply the edit                           5. `git diff --stat` after EVERY trial (10 trials;
#   3. clear every __pycache__ under               every one clean, verified per trial, not once
#      /home/user/skills, then run the named       at the end)
#      pytest selection from reference-impl/
# ⚠️ WHY STEP 3 IS IN THE HARNESS, recorded because it invalidated a trial before it was found:
# `_module_default` imports `dunes`, and CPython validates a .pyc by (source mtime in WHOLE
# SECONDS, source size). A mutation and its revert that both change `hop=5` to `hop=3` and back
# are byte-length-identical and can land in the same second, so the interpreter served the MUTATED
# bytecode against the REVERTED source: the first run of the decoy in row 1 reported RED on a
# clean tree. That is a false RED in a proof register - the worst kind - so every trial below
# clears the caches first and the decoy in row 1 was re-run from scratch. The recorded cell is the
# re-run.
# No mutation was ever applied to a guard file. Every subject is dunes.py or
# references/05-erosion-thermal-aeolian.md - the module and the chapter the guards observe.
# DENOMINATOR - defect classes proved
#   rows with a mutation that went GREEN -> RED .......... 5
#   rows whose decoy stayed GREEN ........................ 5
#   DECORATIVE assertions (could not be made red) ........ 0
# THE FOUR STATEMENTS AND WHICH ROW HOLDS EACH ONE. The constant was stated four ways: 05:413's
# pseudocode block (~5), 05:399's prose note (was ≈3, now ≈5), dunes.py's docstring (~5) and
# dunes.py's signature (was 1, now 5). Row 1 holds block-vs-signature. Rows 2-3 hold
# prose-vs-block-vs-signature from both sides. Rows 4-5 hold the MEANING of the number, so that
# agreement on "5" cannot be preserved while the code stops hopping 5 cells.
